text:
Tariq (Marketing): Quick thread - finalize battlecard wording vs CloudZ, APIHub, and OnPremOps for the webinar next week. Need: 1) single-sentence differentiator vs each competitor, 2) short SDR TL;DR, 3) routing rules for bench mentions + 'latency' or 'cost' keywords.
Greta (Product): Bench sheet link: https://drive.redwood/q2bench 0 main takeaways: ~2x p99 improvement vs CloudZ at 7k tokens with prefix caching; 20-30% unit-cost reduction vs APIHub when batching + KV cache. Measurements run with mixed concurrency.
Samir (Content): I'll do the webinar slide and two social posts. Proposed top line: "Ship real-world LLM features with predictable latency and unit economics across deployments." Want the competitor one-liners to be direct but not aggressive. Suggestions?
Cass (Sales): SDR TL;DR should be 2 lines: 1) problem statement, 2) our value prop, plus 2 quick rebuttals for managed cloud endpoints and self-hosted infra. Keep it super short.
Rae (Growth): Routing rules (pseudocode):
```
if text.contains("benchmark") or text.contains("latency") or text.contains("cost"):
  assign = "solutions-eng"
  add_tags(["needs-battlecard", "bench-request"]) 
elif intent == "purchase" and company.size > 200:
  assign = "enterprise-sales"
else:
  assign = "growth-nurture"
```
Tariq (Marketing): Add a step to ping #sales when 'needs-battlecard' tag set. Also include a webhook payload sample for the team. :link: 
LeadRouterBot: Draft rules received and queued for staging. Test route scheduled.
Greta (Product): Note: call out the caching/quantization config in footnote. Recommend phrase: "scoped to production-like configs (prefix KV caching + mixed batching)."
Samir (Content): Draft copy: "New: consistent latency & predictable unit economics for production LLM apps. See our side-by-side tests vs CloudZ & APIHub." I'll put the p99 and unit-cost callouts on slide 3 with a small footnote.
Cass (Sales): I'll write the TL;DR and rebuttals tonight and post here.
Rae (Growth): I'll add routing rules to playbook and create an AB test for webinar CTAs (bench CTA vs demo CTA).
Tariq (Marketing): Action items: @Greta update bench methodology, @Samir finalize slides + posts, @Cass upload SDR script, @Rae deploy routing + notify. Deck + battlecard by Tue EOD.
Greta (Product): On it  will add methodology notes and CSV export for AE.
LeadRouterBot: Test route completed at 1924089048. Staging payload attached to the ticket.
Tariq (Marketing): Thanks team. If legal flags competitor mentions, we'll use softer "vs leading cloud and API endpoints" copy instead. :+1:
